name: contextia
description: Local, on-device detection of secrets in text before it is sent to an AI chat assistant.

scripts.test: npm run build:engine && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run acceptance && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:dom: npm run build:engine && npm run test:dom --workspace @sbr0nch/contextia-extension
scripts.test:proxy: npm run build:engine && npm run test:proxy --workspace @sbr0nch/contextia
